title: List rows — three styles, clearly labelled

steps.headline: Settings: boxes, lines, or plain rows?
steps.notice: Look at: the rows Account, Assistant settings, Appearance… "Boxed rows" is how it looks today. You already picked plain rows for the right-click menu.

variants.label: Boxed rows · today
variants.summary: Each row sits in its own soft tinted box, with a small gap between boxes.

variants.label: Lines between
variants.summary: No boxes. A thin line separates each row from the next.

variants.label: Plain rows
variants.summary: No boxes and no lines. Rows are told apart only by spacing; hovering highlights one.

steps.risk: Long lists (Settings) and pick-one menus (sessions) may reasonably differ; picking differently here is a real answer.

steps.path: Hold Shift, or open the session list
steps.headline: Sessions: boxes, lines, or plain rows?
